blind.description: An architectural wall corbel or bracket themed around blacksmithing. It features a flat rectangular top shelf supported by ornate sculpts showing an anvil with a large forge hammer resting across it. The sides have curved bracket scrollwork, and the background recess is painted a warm golden-orange. Surfaces are solid, clean, and modeled with weathered dark metal/stone and bronze-highlighted edges. The back is flat for wall mounting, and the bottom tapers to a decorative terminal point hovering just off or resting on the ground.
blind.from_above: A flat rectangular top plate with slightly beveled edges and weathered dark metal texture, casting a stepped shadow to the top-left.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2 to 2.5 feet tall (roughly one-third to two-fifths the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2 feet wide.

notes: footprint slightly shallower than catalog proportions (1.3 ft deep vs 2.0 ft) but fits bracket form well
